title: Impact of Intravitreal Dexamethasone Implant on Vessel Diameters in Patients with Retinal Vein Occlusion

license.statement: Creative Commons Attribution License, version not stated (article <license>: 'open access article distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution License, which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original work is properly cited')

condition: Macular edema secondary to retinal vein occlusion (central 9 eyes, branch 8 eyes), CMT above 300 um, BCVA 5-50 ETDRS letters; prospective observational study (Kocaeli University), 17 eyes of 17 patients, single dexamethasone implant, follow-up 2 months; age- and sex-matched healthy controls not extracted

groups.agent: dexamethasone intravitreal implant 0.7 mg (Ozurdex), one implant at baseline
groups.description: All 17 RVO eyes (CRVO and BRVO pooled; CMT is not tabulated by subgroup)

series.baseline_label: Baseline before injection (Table 1 CMT row, column 2)
series.notes: CMT by Spectralis SD-OCT automated measurement, no subfield definition; mean ± SD (Table 1 footnote: normally distributed values as mean ± SD, others as median with percentiles; the CMT row uses ±); superscript letters mark p < 0.05 comparisons; week 1 converted as 7/30.4375 months; per-visit n not reported; Table 1 gives no unit for CMT, the Results give um and the Methods print the inclusion threshold unit as 'mm'

exclusions.what: Age- and sex-matched healthy control eyes

exclusions.reason: choroidal thickness is out of scope

exclusions.what: Table 1 BCVA and IOP rows (medians with percentiles)
exclusions.reason: visual acuity and IOP are not extracted; medians are not admissible

notes: Prior treatment not stated: exclusion only of anti-VEGF within 3 months and intravitreal steroid within 6 months
